yt_title: Claude can now build in Stackby 🔌 #Shorts
yt_description:
The Stackby MCP connector is here. Build databases, apps and automations in Stackby, right from Claude, ChatGPT or any MCP client.

Ask your assistant to create a stack, add tables and fields, import records, search and update data or set up automations, and it does it directly in your Stackby workspace.

How to add it (about 30 seconds)
1. In Claude: Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector (ChatGPT and other MCP clients have a similar option)
2. Paste the server URL: https://mcp.stackby.com/mcp
3. Sign in with your Stackby account and allow access

👉 Use the Stackby MCP connector today: https://mcp.stackby.com/mcp
New to Stackby? Start free: https://stackby.com/signup
